review.reason: The course layout and mapped features are broadly represented, but added trees crowd the approach from Hole 3’s dogleg fairway to G3, obscuring that route in the overview.

issues.detail: Tree crowns and shadows sit in the gap between the end of the striped fairway and G3, intruding into the approach corridor.
issues.consequence: The Hole 3 fairway-to-green approach reads as obstructed or unclear in the overview.
